body:
■ Commands

Type these in the Kick chat. You earn credits passively just by chatting — once a minute per person.

Credits

!credits <user> (optional)

Shows your credit balance — or someone else's if you name them.also: !coins, !points, !balance

!leaderboard

Shows the top 5 credit holders.also: !top — full list on the stats page

!daily

Claims your free daily credits. Comes back around every 20 hours.

!tip <user> <amount>

Sends some of your credits to another viewer.example: !tip @friend 500 — they need to have chatted before

!site

Posts the website link in chat.

!help

Posts a short list of commands in chat.also: !commands

Casino

!gamble <amount|all>

Coinflip your credits — win and they double, lose and they're gone.example: !gamble 1000 · slots, plinko, mines, dragon tower, cases, keno, blackjack & crash live on the casino page

!plinko <amount|all>

Drops a ball on the plinko board on stream — watch it bounce down and land on your multiplier live on the overlay.example: !plinko 1000 · only while the streamer has the on-screen board switched on, usually during downtime

!enableplinko / !disableplinko

Puts the on-screen plinko board up on stream, or takes it down — the board appears in OBS straight away and chat is told either way.streamer, admins & mods · also: !plinkoon / !plinkooff · the same switch as Admin › Casino

!rob <user>

Tries to pickpocket another viewer — succeed and you take a random cut of their wealth, get caught and you pay them a fine. Stocks count on both sides: a big haul force-sells the victim's shares, and a fine you can't cover in cash dumps yours. The crime page sells gear that tips the odds (or protects you).example: !rob @friend · on a cooldown

!duel <user> <amount>

Challenges another viewer to a coinflip duel for the pot.example: !duel @friend 500 — they have 60 seconds to answer

!accept / !decline

Answers a duel challenge aimed at you.no answer within 60s = challenge expires, challenger refunded

Stock market

!stocks

Lists all tickers with current prices and 1-hour change.

!buy <ticker> <credits>

Spends credits on shares — buying pushes the price up as your order fills.example: !buy STRMR 1000

!sell <ticker> <shares|all>

Sells shares back to credits (a small fee applies) — selling pushes the price down.example: !sell STRMR all

!portfolio <user> (optional)

Shows what you own and your profit/loss — or someone else's portfolio if you name them.

Predictions

!predict <option#> <amount>

Bets on the open prediction — option is its number (1, 2, 3…).example: !predict 1 5000 · one bet per prediction · watch the odds on the Market page or the stream overlay

Raffles

!raffle [tickets]

Buys tickets in the running raffle for a real prize. Every ticket is one more entry in the hat, so the more you buy the better your odds — and the credits are spent either way, win or lose. Leave the number off to see the prize and how your odds are looking.example: !raffle 10 · also: !tickets · full prize details, the odds board and the winner on the raffles page · the streamer draws live, and a cancelled raffle refunds everyone

Fishing

!fish

Casts a line — random catch from common carp to mythic golden koi.free, on a cooldown · sell your catches & browse your collection on the fishing page

!fishsell <all|rarity|species> [count] [best|worst]

Sells the catches sitting in your net without leaving chat — the same sale as the fishing page.examples: !fishsell all · !fishsell common · !fishsell golden koi · a rarity sells that tier only, add a '-' (!fishsell rare-) to sweep everything below it too · add a count to sell part of a stack instead of all of it — !fishsell bass 1 cashes in your most valuable bass, !fishsell bass 2 worst dumps the two cheapest · unsold fish decay, so a full net is a bleeding net

!treasure

One free dig per day at a chest that pays out across the whole site — fishing gear (usually bait or a lure, with the rods, net and freezer very rare), criminal kit like a lockpick or a decoy wallet, a purse of credits, or a contract for one of your businesses.the live odds are on the fishing page · anything you can't use — a rod you already own, a manager with no shop to run — pays out worm bait or credits instead, so a dig is never wasted

!cook <item>

Cooks spare catches into gear — 3 commons make worm bait, 5 uncommons make a lucky lure.example: !cook bait · type !cook for the recipe list · eats your cheapest fish of that tier first, so trophies stay safe

!prestige

Hands in a complete collection log for the 🎣 Master Angler badge and a fresh, empty log.needs all 100 species caught on your current run · your net is cashed in on the way out · gear, credits, channel records and lifetime totals all stay · prestige again as often as you can fill the log, and the badge counts them

Business

!business

Shows what you run, what's sitting in the tills and what it all earns an hour.also: !biz · buy, upgrade and secure your businesses on the business page

!collect

Empties every till you own into your balance. A business keeps earning until its till is full and then stops, so collecting regularly is the whole game — and a boom or a business event can swing what you walk away with.also: !cashout · a manager triples how much a till can hold if you can't check in often

Trading hours

Your shops earn their full rate while the stream is live and a fraction of it once the stream ends — the money is in turning up. It makes no difference when you collect: a till that filled across a stream starting keeps both rates exactly as they happened.type !business to see whether your shops are open or shut right now

Off the books

Some of the catalog is illegal, and it pays dirty money into a separate stash that buys nothing until it's washed. It earns more per credit invested than anything legal — but every collection is a roll against the police, and a raid seizes the till, fines you and shuts the place for hours. Payoffs cut those odds by up to three quarters.!rob can't touch an illegal till — legal shops risk robbery, illegal ones risk raids

!wash

Washes dirty money through the legal businesses you run, minus a fee. Each legal shop launders a share of its own hourly income, and unused capacity banks up — so how much dirty money you can actually spend depends on how many honest fronts you keep alongside the labs.also: !launder · run nothing but illegal shops and you'll pile up money you can't touch

!empire [user]

Looks up what someone runs and what it earns.example: !empire @someone · leave the name off for your own

!rob <user>

Uncollected takings are cash in a register, and no safe or vault covers them — an untended till is the easiest money in the channel to steal. Security on a business hides up to three quarters of its till; collecting hides all of it.see the Credits tab for the rest of how !rob works · illegal tills hold dirty money, so a robber can't reach them at all

TTS

!tts <message>

Pays credits to have your message read out loud on stream.cost and rules on the home page — no links

Fun

!cock [user]

Measures your cock — or someone else's if you name them.example: !cock or !cock @someone · purely for the lols, 0–12 inches

!boobs [user]

Measures your boobs — or someone else's if you name them.example: !boobs or !boobs @someone · purely for the lols, random 34 AA–G cup

Streamer & admins

!ttson / !ttsoff

Turns TTS on or off for everyone.streamer & admins

!pump <ticker>

Shoves a stock's price up and announces it in chat.streamer & admins · example: !pump STRMR

!dump <ticker>

Shoves a stock's price down and announces it in chat.streamer & admins

!chest <amount> [trigger word]

Drops a credit chest — everyone who types the trigger word within 30 seconds splits it. The word defaults to W; anything after the amount becomes the trigger (e.g. !chest 1000 good stream).streamer only, since the credits are minted · also available from the admin panel

!frenzy [seconds|stop]

Starts a fishing frenzy — the !fish cooldown drops to zero for everyone until it ends, announced in chat and bannered on the overlay. Defaults to the length set in Admin › Fishing (30s); !frenzy stop ends one early.streamer & admins · also: !fishfrenzy / !fishingfrenzy · also available from the admin panel

!boom [hours]

Drops that many hours of takings into every business till in the channel at once, announced in chat. A full till can't take any more, so a boom rewards whoever has been collecting.streamer & admins, since the credits are minted · also: !businessboom · also available from the admin panel
